_about: The one list of Atlas storage keys, databases and ids. archived: data an archived feature left in profiles; kept, not used. The bundles import it, install.py reads it, and tests/unit/storage_keys.test.js checks that code and this file agree. Never rename a key: stored user data uses these names. default: value when the key is absent. backup: carried by Export/Import. importWhen: 'defined' restores any value that is not undefined, 'truthy' only a truthy one. profile: the profilesCore.js category that owns it when profiles keep separate settings.

activeTabs.note: Pages list: {id, label, type, sub}; sub is the subtitle under the name (services/pageSubtitle.js). Export takes it from memory, not storage.

default._comment: Theme settings: 'system' <- Follows System settings (Light/Dark). 'dark' <- Forces standard Dark mode. 'light' <- Forces standard Light mode. 'custom' <- Uses the CustomColors mapped below. Note: To apply changes, reload the page.

uiScale.note: Legacy: the UI scale, removed from Settings. Nothing reads it; a saved value is ignored, so every new tab is at 100%.

pendingIncrease.note: Legacy: a tab-limit increase queued for 30 minutes by the version before the Focus locks. Still finished on time (background/pendingChanges.js); no longer written.

pendingDelayDecrease.note: Legacy: a search-delay decrease queued for 30 minutes by the version before the Focus locks. Still finished on time (background/pendingChanges.js); no longer written.

grayscale.note: Legacy: the old on/off switch. Read once and folded into saturation (utils/saturationLock.js legacySaturation), then removed.

saturation.note: Color level for web pages, 0 to 100. 100 is full color.

saturationLock.note: Legacy: the color lock before the Focus locks, { ceiling, until, manual }. Moved into focusLocks once at startup (background/saturationMigration.js), then removed.

focusLocks.note: The locks on Settings > Focus (utils/focusLock.js): { tabLimit | searchDelaySeconds | saturation: { unlockAt } }, unlockAt null while locked or the time its 30-minute unlock ends. Not per profile and not in backups, so a switch or an import can't undo a lock.

bookmarks-migrated.note: Legacy: set once bookmarks moved from sync storage to IndexedDB.

bookmarks-page-1.note: Legacy bookmark storage, read once by migrateFromChromeStorage.

syncPatterns.page<id>: Legacy per-page bookmark key, removed when a page is deleted (tabs.js).

_themeCache.note: Theme preference copy for first paint in other pages.

rhe_rules.note: Element Remover rules (archived feature); still carried by backups.

activeDelays.note: Service worker: search delays in progress.

atlas_usage.note: Usage totals per site and hour (utils/usageLog.js), written by the service worker, shown in Settings > Usage. Never backed up.

atlasGoogleAccounts.note: Google accounts signed into Vivaldi, read by the browser window (src/modules/16-google-accounts.js). Never backed up.

__atlas_localstorage__.note: Backing store of the localStorage shim (atlas-localstorage-shim.js).

pastekit.settings.note: PasteKit settings (archived feature). Left in place; no code reads it now.

atlas_scroll_telemetry.note: The first scroll logs (replaced by atlas_usage, 2026-10-15). Left in place; nothing writes or reads it now.

rheTabStates.note: Element Remover per-tab state (archived feature). Left in place; no code reads it now.

localStorage._themeCache: Theme preference for the first paint (themePreinit.js).
localStorage._scaleCache: Legacy: the UI scale's first-paint copy. preinit.js removes it.
localStorage.uiScale: Legacy scale value. preinit.js removes it.
localStorage.themePref: Legacy theme value, migrated into IndexedDB uiPrefs.
